reviews.text: Great mist for summer time. Strong scent but I don’t mind it. Not sure about its effects but I like using it as it’s very fine mist
reviews.zh: 夏天用嘅好噴霧。味道偏濃但我唔介意。功效方面唔太確定，但噴出嚟好幼細所以幾鍾意用。

reviews.text: Very good, I use it before the skincare routine, after cleansing and then you use it and then use all your skincare products
reviews.zh: 好好用，我喺護膚程序前用，潔面後就用佢，之後再用其他護膚品。

reviews.text: On a day when my skin feels dry, but i couldn't be bother to put another layer of moisturiser, this bottle is super handy.
reviews.zh: 皮膚覺得乾嘅日子，但又懶得再搽多層保濕霜，呢支就啱晒用。

reviews.text: I used this on really hot days to keep my skin fresh and hydrated. It is handy to carry around and works really well.
reviews.zh: 我喺好熱嘅日子用佢嚟保持皮膚清爽同保濕。方便攜帶，而且效果好好。

reviews.text:
Great pick me up refresh when at home. 
Great to help cool down in the heat when stored in the fridge.
Repurchase again.
reviews.zh:
喺屋企用嚟提神醒神一流。
放入雪櫃後喺熱到爆嘅時候用嚟降溫超正。
會再回購。

reviews.text: Not sure yet whether this product will help maintain hydration throughout the day. Initially post spray my skin feels a little tacky but that settles quickly. There is quite a strong scent which I don’t mind but others might not like. Scent quickly disappears
reviews.zh: 未確定呢隻產品可唔可以幫手維持全日保濕。剛噴完皮膚會有少少黏笠感，但好快就消退。味道幾濃，我唔介意但其他人可能會唔鍾意。味道好快就散。

reviews.text: Definitely has a scent to it. It’s not a bad scent, but I have sensitive skin so I usually stay away from scents. That being said, I used it over the top of my makeup for the last two days and I like the effect. I feel like my makeup looks smoother longer and I haven’t had any reaction to it.
reviews.zh: 真係有味道。唔算難聞，但我係敏感肌，一般會避開有香味嘅產品。話雖如此，我連續兩日喺妝上面用，幾鍾意個效果。覺得妝望落去更加貼順持久，而且我完全冇任何敏感反應。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
